verdict.rationale: Recurly documents self-service flows like a Cancel/Save survey and in-app payment-update prompts via Recurly Engage (docs-25, docs-26), and change-subscription docs cover upgrade/downgrade/add-on logic (docs-1, docs-16), but the evidence never explicitly describes a customer-facing hosted portal or embeddable component that lets end customers themselves change plans/quantity without merchant/support involvement — the change-subscription docs read as merchant/API-driven actions rather than a self-serve UI. missing for 10: explicit hosted customer portal or embeddable upgrade/downgrade UI, evidence that customers (not merchants) initiate plan changes themselves, independent corroboration of self-serve portal usage.
